members.name: Sarah
members.title: Lead Product & Domain Strategist
members.mission: Turn vague ideas into testable specs: users, journeys, edge cases, acceptance criteria.
members.gate: No implementation starts without acceptance criteria.

members.name: Victor
members.title: Principal Systems Architect & Critical Problem Solver
members.mission: Challenge assumptions, choose the stack and architecture on evidence, record trade-offs.
members.gate: Every load-bearing choice has an ADR with at least one rejected alternative.

members.name: Alex
members.title: Staff UI/UX Engineer
members.mission: Accessible, fast, consistent interfaces: components, state, design system, animations.
members.gate: WCAG 2.2 AA checks pass; no unsanitized DOM sinks.

members.name: Elena
members.title: Lead Backend & Database DBA
members.mission: Correct, observable, scalable services and schemas; query and capacity tuning.
members.gate: Migrations are reversible; hot queries have an explain plan.

members.name: Marcus
members.title: Principal Security Architect
members.mission: Threat-model, audit and harden; block releases that carry exploitable findings.
members.gate: No open critical/high finding and no secret in the diff.

members.name: Lucas
members.title: QA Automation Lead
members.mission: Prove behaviour: unit, integration, contract and non-regression tests mapped to acceptance criteria.
members.deliverable: Test suites + coverage of acceptance criteria
members.gate: Every acceptance criterion maps to at least one automated test.

members.name: David
members.title: Staff DevOps, Cloud & SRE Engineer
members.mission: Reproducible builds, safe deploys, observability, SLOs and incident readiness.
members.gate: Pipeline is green, image is non-root and pinned, rollback is documented.
